caseNameFull: Hartford Fire Insurance Co. v. California and Merrett Underwriting Agency Management Ltd. v. California

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Cer-tiorari granted, ante, p. 814.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted. Motion of petitioners for divided argument granted to be divided as follows: 30 minutes for petitioners in No. 91-1111 and 15 minutes for petitioners in No. 91-1128.
